command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/body-resident.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-body-shoulder-microkinematics-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SRC="$TMP/repo/handoff/avatar-body-shoulder-microkinematics-20260912/body_player_composition_ab.py"
DST="$TMP/resident.py"
python3 - "$SRC" "$DST" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
old="if(frame%hold===0){ai=(ai+1)%arr.length;if(ai===0)namei=(namei+1)%names.length}"
assert s.count(old)==1,s.count(old)
s=s.replace(old,"if(false){ai=(ai+1)%arr.length;if(ai===0)namei=(namei+1)%names.length}",1)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(s)
PY
sha256sum "$SRC" "$DST"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$DST" --visual-root "$ROOT" --chrome /usr/bin/google-chrome --timeout 80 | tee "$TMP/report.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
python3 - "$TMP/report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.loads(open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()[-1]); assert not r.get('error'),r; assert r['gl_error']==0
print('RESIDENT_TEXTURE_CONTROL',json.dumps({'base':r['base'],'warp':r['warp'],'renderer':r['renderer']},sort_keys=True))
PY
echo SCOPE=REAL_HOST_READ_ONLY_RESIDENT_TEXTURE_CONTROL_NO_SOURCE_WRITE
